events.title: CORRUPTION: Persephone's Masquerade
events.description:
Corruption presents PERSEPHONE'S MASQUERADE

The veil grows thin and calls for deviance. Clasp the reins of your false face. Dance in discordant revelry.

"...Sail, tonight, the Styx's breast;
Glide among the dim processions
Of the exquisite unblest,
Spirits of my shared transgressions,

Roam with young Persephone.
Plucking poppies for your slumber...
With the morrow, there shall be
One more wraith among your number"

Two stages of relentless rhythms, distorted hooks, and cold machine energy built for dark rooms and total surrender.

Exclusive libations available at the steel apothecary.

Come clean. Leave corrupted.

[Cash only for entry. ATM in the entrance]

events.title: TEC-TROIT ELECTRONIC MUSIC FESTIVAL
events.description: Tec-Troit is an all ages, family friendly, 3 day, free Techno and house music festival located in Detroit MI. The festival focuses on spotlighting Detroit based musicians and artist. Meaning the festival only books the hard working musicians that grind it out week to week in the city. Luckily Detroit is home to Techno and there are plenty of talented artists to perform. Along with this, Tec-Troit is committed to educating the youth and the community about this Detroit created music style that has taken the world by storm called Techno. To achieve this, we offer workshops and lectures from prominent Detroit musicians. Come join us to listen, dance and learn about Detroit Techno music!
